Spallation neutron source with 1 GeV protons
with pulse width of 1 mu-s and repetition rate of 60Hz
impinging on liquid mercury target. Decoupled poisoned
ambient temperature water moderator is used with T0
chopper to reduce flash of high energy neutron
background and  Fine Resolution Fermi Chopper
Spectrometer(SEQUOIA).Source-to-Fermi chopper distance
was 18 m. SEQUOIA has two Fermi choppers located 2 m
in front of sample position.
Choppers rotate at speeds up to 600 Hz and are phase
locked to the source pulse to better than 1 mu-s.
Incident neutron range is 15-1500meV and energy
resolution for the instrument is 2-5%

Wide Angular-Range Chopper Spectrometer (ARCS)
was used in experiment. ARCS detector consist of
cylindrical array of 115 modules of 8 one meter long
3He linear position sensitive detectors in combined

Spallation neutron source with 1 GeV protons
with pulse width of 1 mu-s and repetition rate of 60Hz
impinging on liquid mercury target. Decoupled ambient
temperature water moderator is used with Wide Angular-
Range Chopper  Spectrometer (ARCS). ARCS has two Fermi
choppers located 2.8 m in front of sample position.
Choppers rotate at speeds up to 600 Hz and are phase
locked to the source pulse to better than 1 mu-s.
Incident neutron range is 15-1500meV and energy
resolution for the instrument: 2-5%
